```yaml
name: Check Devin PR Assignee

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  check-devin-assignee:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR has devin label
        id: check_label
        run: |
          LABELS=$(jq -r '.pull_request.labels[].name' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)
          HAS_DEVIN_LABEL=$(echo "$LABELS" | grep -c "devin")
          echo "has_devin_label=$HAS_DEVIN_LABEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check if PR is assigned to devin
        id: check_assignee
        run: |
          ASSIGNEES=$(jq -r '.pull_request.assignees[].login' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)
          HAS_DEVIN_ASSIGNEE=$(echo "$ASSIGNEES" | grep -c "devin")
          echo "has_devin_assignee=$HAS_DEVIN_ASSIGNEE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Fail if PR lacks devin label and assignee
        if: ${{ steps.check_label.outputs.has_devin_label == 0 && steps.check_assignee.outputs.has_devin_assignee == 0 }}
        run: |
          echo "Error: Pull request must have either the 'devin' label or be assigned to 'devin'"
          exit 1

      - name: Log success
        if: ${{ steps.check_label.outputs.has_devin_label == 1 || steps.check_assignee.outputs.has_devin_assignee == 1 }}
        run: |
          echo "Pull request meets Devin requirements"
```
